decisions.reason: The book-cover dimensions and cropping belong to the separate cover-presentation Requirement. The candidate already records the independently requested layout and overlap corrections from the same message.
Changing the landing-page book-cover dimensions and cropping does not alter the FAQ content.
The source change concerns the landing-page cover image and does not modify the About-page content.
Book-cover sizing and cropping do not change the established Harbor Quill or ArchiveLedger product names.
The landing-page book-cover presentation has no effect on email authentication or dashboard access.
The source change does not alter email delivery, notifications, or confirmation-email contents.
Book-cover dimensions and cropping do not affect SIWE or wallet-based access.
The cover-presentation change does not affect authentication requirements or information exposed by public APIs.
The source decision changes only landing-page cover presentation and does not alter automatic prize payout behavior.
Presentation of the book cover on the landing page does not change what follows the NFT upon transfer.
The source change does not affect the deferred Transak fiat-minting flow or its wallet-provisioning rules.
The landing-page book-cover image is unrelated to the badge set, icons, and badge presentation.
